english.title: Fish within Portland Harbour
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) fished

(A)_[in the main fairways of Portland Harbour]_
(B)_[in the controlled area of Portland Harbour]_
(C)_[within 150 metres of the harbour premises in Portland Harbour]_
(D)_[by trawl, nets or dredges within 100 metres of a line of cable or pipe laid down in Portland Harbour]_
(E)_[with surface nets in the inner harbour of Portland Harbour, other than with the written permission of the harbour master]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 43(2) and 60(1)(b) of Schedule 1 to the Portland Harbour Revision Order 1997.
